title: Baseline Complete
description: Emitted once per compared item during an A/B baseline run, after the harness arm and baseline arm both finish executing in parallel and before the blind comparator runs.

run_id.description: Run-scoped identity, stable across a run (including pause/resume). Stamped by FSMExecutor._emit()-routed events (ENH-3345) and by every parallel.* emitter (ENH-3346); required on all parallel.* events, optional elsewhere.

loop.description: Loop name, stamped on every FSMExecutor._emit()-routed event (ENH-3345). Not required for the same reason as run_id.

harness_duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the harness arm, in ms

baseline_duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the baseline arm, in ms

harness_tokens.description: Total tokens (input + output) consumed by the harness arm

baseline_tokens.description: Total tokens (input + output) consumed by the baseline arm
